# Keys `github-env.sh` may write to the runner env file, one per line.
# `verify-manifest.py` refuses a key that names the rustc wrapper/sccache wiring
# (owned by `.github/actions/sccache`), an interpreter/loader hook (PATH,
# LD_PRELOAD, BASH_ENV, NODE_OPTIONS, ...), or a runner-reserved prefix.
BIN_NAME
GEO_CLIPBOARD_BIN
GEO_SERVER_PID
IPE_GEO_CLIPBOARD_EMITTED
IPE_PUBLISH_SIGNING_KEY
